arc: hook (hard-cut statement → 3, 2, 1 countdown → 'Don’t blink' → 'Meet Astra.') → feature ×4 (computer use, long-horizon, builds, math & cyber as rapid word-per-beat cards) → logo (stat, name, 'Don’t blink', mark)

scenes.title: Hard-cut countdown 3-2-1 into 'Meet Astra.'
scenes.summary: Pure black frame, white bold SF type dead centre, every change a hard cut on the music grid: 'Your computer' / 'has a new user.', then screen-filling 900px digits 3, 2 (inverted white card with a 2-frame strobe), 1, a tiny 'Don’t', a bleed-size inverted 'blink', 'Meet', and 'Astra.' at 268px.
scenes.build: Just a SCRIPT array of {t, u, size, invert, flash, fs} passed to <Cards> from components/kinetic.tsx, which schedules cards on a UNIT=10-frame eighth-note grid (90 BPM at 30fps) and renders exactly one card per frame — no easing; `flash` paints the first 2 frames solid as a strobe, `invert` swaps black/white. Copy kinetic.tsx with it.
scenes.reuse: Any Apple 'Don’t Blink'-style cold open or countdown: rewrite the SCRIPT strings and units to your track's tempo (adjust UNIT). Size steps (sm/md/lg/xl/bleed) give the rhythm; inverted+flash cards are the percussive accents. Don't keep the Astra/OpenAI name.

scenes.title: Rapid-fire word cards: 'It uses your computer.'
scenes.summary: One word per beat on black: 'It' 'uses' 'your' 'computer.' (large), 'Clicks.' 'Types.' 'Scrolls.' 'Any' 'app.' 'No' 'API' then 'needed.' on an inverted white strobe card, 'Just' 'a' 'cursor.' (large).
scenes.build: A SCRIPT of half-unit (5-frame) word cards with longer, larger cards at phrase ends, fed to <Cards> in components/kinetic.tsx.
scenes.reuse: The cleanest example in this template of pacing a feature claim word-per-beat: short words at 0.5u, the payoff word larger and held 1.25u, one inverted accent per scene. Swap the words for your feature.

scenes.title: Word cards: 'Walk away. Forty minutes later: Done.'
scenes.summary: Hard-cut word cards: 'Give' 'it' 'a' 'task.' 'Walk' 'away.' 'Forty' 'minutes' 'later:' then 'Done.' large on an inverted strobe card, 'It' 'doesn’t' 'forget.'
scenes.build: Same <Cards> machine from components/kinetic.tsx with a different SCRIPT; nothing scene-specific.
scenes.reuse: Near-duplicate of 02-computer-use in technique; borrow the copy rhythm only. Study 01 or 02 for the device.

scenes.title: Word cards: 'It codes. It tests. It ships.'
scenes.summary: Hard-cut word cards: 'It' 'codes.' 'It' 'tests.' 'It' 'ships.' 'It' 'builds' 'in' then '3D.' at xl size, 'From' 'a' 'photo.' 'One' and 'shot.' large on an inverted card (no strobe).
scenes.build: Same <Cards> machine from components/kinetic.tsx with a different SCRIPT.
scenes.reuse: Near-duplicate of 02-computer-use; the 'It X. It Y. It Z.' triplet is the only idea worth lifting.

scenes.title: Word cards ending on bleed 'Critical.'
scenes.summary: Hard-cut word cards: 'Math.' 'Primes.' 'Untouched' 'since' 'the' '1930s.' 'It' 'finds' 'flaws' 'nobody' 'knew' 'existed.' 'OpenAI’s' 'rating:' then 'Critical.' at 580px on an inverted strobe card.
scenes.build: Same <Cards> machine from components/kinetic.tsx; the closer uses an explicit fs to make a bleed word fit the frame.
scenes.reuse: Near-duplicate of 02-computer-use; the oversized inverted final word is the one variation.

scenes.title: Stat, name, 'Don’t blink', then logo mark card
scenes.summary: '1.9×' at xl size, 'faster.' 'Their' 'most' 'aligned.', the name 'GPT-6 Astra' large, 'Don’t', a bleed inverted strobe 'blink', and finally the white OpenAI blossom mark alone on black at 300px.
scenes.build: <Cards> SCRIPT whose last card uses `node: <MarkCard src={blossom} size={300} />` in place of text — the way to end a hard-cut sequence on a logo. Both from components/kinetic.tsx.
scenes.reuse: Close any kinetic-type film: swap the stat, name and the mark SVG. Don't ship the OpenAI mark or the GPT-6 name.
